scope: Replace native selectable-but-keyboard-only Mouse Aim with the shipped cursor conditioner; hold F for temporary SAS inversion; enforce exclusive camera/UI/focus ownership. No new physics/control law or wire payload.

contract.conditioner: flight-authority::input::mouse_aim_direction uses 6% NDC deadband, 0.94 remapping and normalized forward direction. Both clients consume it. manual_control_input maps (direction.y,direction.x,0)*0.85 when Mouse Aim has no keyboard demand, otherwise keyboard wins. Unit-limit the vector before 0.25 precision scaling.
contract.behavior_correction: The previous native diagonal keyboard demand was not unit-limited before precision, unlike the old pilot. It now uses the shared final conditioner. Raw stick_scaled remains a mapping diagnostic, not final authority demand.
contract.ownership: Camera right/middle gestures and pointer-owned widgets suppress cursor steering; keyboard-owned widgets suppress held stick, throttle slew and SAS override. Missing/unfocused cursor and cursor-leave are neutral. Paused/x0 demands have zero control axes. Focus loss/suspension clears cursor and held F along with the existing held keys/gestures.
contract.sas: Retain base enabled demand separately from held inversion; effective demand is XOR, repeated frames never toggle. HUD edits the base. The lean Snapshot does not acknowledge SAS; packet acceptance is not acknowledgement. Local/server control laws remain the only actuator/pose path.
contract.resources: Constant host input arithmetic only; no new crate/dependency, shader, GPU pass, device, thread, queue or authoritative state. Headless capture has no pointer and remains neutral and silent.

targeted_checks.shared: cargo test -p thessa-flight-authority input::tests --lib: 5 passed, including 1323 grid points over landscape/portrait and scaled viewports bit-identical to an independent transcription of the old f32 conditioner. Cardinal pitch/yaw absolute tolerance 1e-7, invalid/missing pointer/viewport neutral, keyboard priority, precision, repeats and changed base while F held.
targeted_checks.native: cargo test -p thessa-terrain-native --bin thessa-terrain-native: 61 passed at targeted run, 22 deferred hardware/benchmark tests. New ownership test covers camera, widgets, keyboard capture, missing pointer, manual takeover and pause; extended focus-loss test clears pointer and SAS override. Snapshot/input test validates mouse/SAS wire demand without local authoritative pose mutation.
targeted_checks.clippy: workspace all-target/all-feature -D warnings passed at targeted run; third-party C unused-function warnings are outside Rust lint gates.

verification.status: all fourteen final local gates passed on unchanged compiled sources
